deadline.value: Applications for Fall, including fellowship consideration, are due January 14.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Fall and for those desiring fellowship consideration is January 14.

app_fee.value: The department states the same $50 fee as the university.

fee_waiver.value: Waiver requests go to the graduate administrator by December 20 and count only for complete applications that meet all requirements.
fee_waiver.quote: The request must be received on or before December 20

gre_general.value: The chemistry pages fetched do not mention the GRE.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

english_waiver.value: The department's exempt list has no India, so Indian applicants need an English test.
english_waiver.quote: Only applicants who are citizens of the United States, Canada, the U.K., the Republic of Ireland, New Zealand, or Australia

supervisor.value: Students join a research group only after admission, following a first-semester rotation.
supervisor.quote: Admitted students do not join research groups until the end of their first semester.

funding.value: Students making normal progress are guaranteed assistantships for the usual PhD length.
funding.quote: guaranteed assistantships for the 2-2.5 years usually needed to complete an MS degree or for the 4-5.5 years usually needed to complete a PhD degree

entry_route.value: Admission requires a four-year bachelor's degree in chemistry or a closely related field; the page names no master's requirement.
entry_route.quote: Hold the equivalent of a 4-year US-accredited baccalaureate degree in chemistry or biochemistry

notes: The FAQ confirms the PhD and its tuition waiver (54 credit hours). The department's English exemption list differs from the university list, but India is on neither. A TOEFL minimum of 85 iBT appears on the admissions page on the old scale; not used.
